The PrintNightmare vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228) is a critical security flaw in Microsoft's PrintNightmare.dll library, which is used by Windows Print and Document Services. To identify vulnerable systems, an attacker can use tools like Nessus, OpenVAS, or the Microsoft Baseline Security Analyzer (MSBA). These tools can scan the network for vulnerable systems and provide details on the affected systems.
